lessons.title: The response contract
lessons.why: Connect does not debug your function. It branches.
paras: Match the block's response validation. A string map is a flat object of strings. JSON validation allows nested JSON. The re:Post guidance says to keep the payload small, with 32 KB as the figure people hit, and to restrict values to characters Connect accepts when you are on a string map.
Print the ContactId. Correlate by time only if you forgot.
points: Timeouts in the Lambda console must be higher than the block timeout or you will add a second failure mode.
Cold starts count against the 8 seconds.
Secrets stay in the function environment or in Secrets Manager, not in flow attributes.
lessons.mistake: Returning a Python dict with numbers and lists to a string-map block.

number.n: On throttle or HTTP 500, until the block timeout

lessons.title: When the work is slower than eight seconds
lessons.why: Silence is a defect. Async plus a prompt is the pattern.
paras: Set the block to asynchronous. Play a prompt. Use Wait if you must observe completion, up to 60 seconds. Do not chain synchronous calls until you pass 20 seconds in total.
If the result is only needed by the agent, write it to a profile or a case and let the workspace load it. The caller does not have to wait on the phone.
points: Tell the caller what is happening.
A timeout branch still needs a prompt.
Long work belongs in a queue or a task, not in the greet flow.
Measure duration in CloudWatch before you argue about the flow.
lessons.mistake: A synchronous chain of four CRM calls at the start of every inbound call.

lessons.title: Association, resource policy, and the log that says AccessDenied
lessons.why: The flow log is telling the truth. The function never ran.
paras: AccessDenied in the flow log means Connect could not invoke the function. Add the function on the instance and allow connect.amazonaws.com to invoke that version or alias. A permission on the flow author is irrelevant at runtime.
If there is no Lambda log line at all, you are in this case or the payload was rejected. If there is a log line, the bug is inside the function.
points: Use an alias, not $LATEST, in production.
Resource-based policy and identity policy answer different questions.
VPC-attached functions need a path to their dependency and still must return in time.
Terraform's association resource is the reviewable form of the console click.
lessons.mistake: Adding lambda:InvokeFunction to the admin user and retesting the call.
